missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Юноша' is a masculine noun with feminine-type endings, here nominative as the subject of 'читает'. 'Молодой' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Юношу' is the accusative object of 'знаю'; the ending '-у' follows the first-declension pattern. 'Этого' agrees in the animate masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Юноши' is the genitive form in the frame 'у юноши есть' showing what the youth has. 'Мечта' is the nominative subject of 'есть'.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Юноше' is the dative form required by 'помогает'. 'Молодому' agrees in the masculine dative. 'Учитель' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Юношей' is the instrumental form governed by 'гордится'. 'Своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental. 'Девушка' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Юноше' is the prepositional form after 'об' meaning about the youth. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional. 'Все' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative agent. 'Юноша' is the nominative subject performing 'подарил'. 'Девушке' is the dative recipient and 'цветы' is the accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Юноши' is the nominative plural subject of 'собрались'. 'Молодые' is the agreeing plural adjective and 'на площади' marks the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural for animate accusative. After 'трёх' the animate noun takes 'юношей', the genitive plural also serving as the accusative. 'Учитель' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Юноша' is the nominative subject described by the short-form adjective 'талантлив', which agrees in the masculine. 'Этот' points at the specific youth.
